svg.title: Recalculate after the observed sample is restricted
svg.desc: In a separate explicitly fictional Aa×Aa model, genotype weights at conception are AA1/4,Aa1/2,aa1/4, but AA is lethal before scoring. Excluding AA leaves total probability3/4, so conditional survivor probabilities are Aa2/3 and aa1/3. The observed expected2:1 ratio therefore reflects survival rather than a changed meiotic segregation rule. This model must not be silently combined with the recessive-aa-affected pedigree model. Retain the scoring time and condition when comparing model predictions.

g.text: Recalculate after the observed sample is restricted
Survival, sex and phenotype can change a probability denominator.
Fictional Aa × Aa model: AA is lethal before the offspring are counted.
P(Aa | survived) = (½) / (¾) = ⅔; P(aa | survived) = (¼) / (¾) = ⅓.
Among survivors the expected ratio is 2 Aa : 1 aa.
This changes the comparison set; it does not change segregation at conception.
Do not transfer this fictional lethal model to the separate aa-affected pedigree model.
